leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define a structured type for image data with required properties
Implement React state hooks to manage the loading status of individual images
Use the Intersection Observer API to detect when images enter the viewport
Construct a custom hook to encapsulate lazy loading logic and make it reusable
Execute conditional rendering to display loading placeholders while images are not visible
Assign appropriate CSS classes to control the visibility and transitions of lazy-loaded images
Handle Intersection Observer callbacks to update component state when visibility changes
Utilize the useEffect hook to set up and clean up Intersection Observer instances
Control image loading behavior by conditionally applying the src attribute based on visibility
Define a reusable LazyImage component that accepts image data props and implements lazy loading
Invoke the custom lazy loading hook within components to enable lazy loading functionality
Modify image rendering to include fallback content or error handling for failed loads
